listing.name: Player IP Flag Pack v2.1
listing.summary: Flag mod that adds multiple franchise flags from things like Star Wars, Halo, The Expanse, etc. Also includes some original designs from people.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a large collection of science fiction faction flags and crests contributed by various community members.

description:
Using an IP mod but don't like how it was made? Want to larp as a faction that there isn't a mod for yet? Just looking for new flags to use? Look no further! This mod will bring you everything you could possibly want from across science fiction!

Below is a selection of flags contributed by people both in and out of the Unoffical Starsector Discord:

By Rain [close]

By Emanator of Chair [close]

By Bernie von Bernie; Jinkus [close]

By iballisticperidot [close]

Redesigns by Vexlia Artemiss [close]

By me :3 [close]

There's alternate versions of flags if you want to use them. They're listed below

To use them, add a number to the flag name in the mod's data file. [close]

Changelogs

v2.1:

Added credits in mod_info to flags and crests that needed them. If there's more I need to add let me know.

Changed the MCRN flag.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

v2.0:

Updated many existing flag designs.

Added new flags.

Actually fixed the Laterano bug.

Removed SOULs and EFN flags.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

v1.1:

Fixed a bug that made the Laterano flag crash the game (I hate javascript)[close]

Download link:

https://github.com/Antocerzch/Player-IP-Flag-Pack-v2.1

Make sure to download the latest version of this mod. It should be the one on top, otherwise look for the highest number.
